article.hook: That sudden urge to jump before the plan is fully clear? It’s Jupiter pushing through Aries, daring you to bet on yourself. Watch the impulse to start loud and fast - it’s a whole year-long invitation to lead with guts, not caution.
article.lived: For the next year or so, bold moves grow bigger under this transit. You’ll see it in the way decisions speed up - meetings that end with action, projects launched on a hunch, teams rallying around someone who just takes charge. The pace picks up, and the spotlight shines on the first to step forward, the first to risk the unknown. It’s a season of expansion through gutsy independence, where growth comes by doing, not waiting.
article.turn: The catch is how quickly bold turns brittle. That same push to act fast can slam into walls built by haste - missed details, overlooked advice, burning out the people who sprint after you. Courage without pause slides into stubborn recklessness. When you run at full speed without checking the ground, you crash harder than if you’d slowed down.
